arithmetic_floor.consequence: no set of fewer than k_floor deletions can change the criterion on this case, whatever its labels are. Robustness below k_floor is arithmetic and is not evidence about the annotation
arithmetic_floor.why: one deletion moves one anchor's gain by at most one, so the decision moves by at most (a + b) times that anchor's weight

same_anchor_control.note: two carriers inside one anchor are not guaranteed independent; this is recorded as an adversarial control on the construction

why_no_exhaustive_pair_search: the floor is 2, so no set of size 1 can cross and any size 2 set that crosses is minimal. A single verified witness therefore settles k_observed exactly, and enumerating all 271216 pairs would establish nothing further about the minimum
witness_construction: matching is computed per anchor, so two gain carrying labels in different anchors each remove one unit of gain independently. Each unit costs (a+b)*weight = 1/7, so the pair removes 2/7 and the decision reaches 0, at or below the tolerance. The construction is then verified by full recomputation rather than trusted
